name: Video Embed Rutube
project_description:
Video Embed Rutube adds Rutube as a provider handler for the Video Embed Field module. Once enabled, an editor can paste a Rutube video URL (for example https://rutube.ru/video/<hash>/) into any Video Embed Field and it renders as an embedded Rutube player plus a downloadable thumbnail, exactly like the YouTube and Vimeo providers that ship with Video Embed Field.

The module is a single provider plugin. It recognises rutube.ru /video/ and /shorts/ URLs, extracts the 32-character hex video id, builds an https://rutube.ru/play/embed/<id> iframe (honouring the field's width, height and autoplay settings and a ?t= start-time from the source URL), and fetches the poster image from Rutube's oEmbed endpoint (https://rutube.ru/api/oembed/) for use as the local thumbnail.

Rutube is a major Russian video platform, so this is the practical choice for sites whose audience or content cannot rely on YouTube. All field-type, formatter, WYSIWYG and Media-source plumbing comes from the parent Video Embed Field module; this project only teaches it how to talk to Rutube.

Requires Video Embed Field 3.x. Version 3.0 supports Drupal >=10.3 and 11; the older 8.x-1.5 branch supports Drupal >=9.2 and 10 with Video Embed Field 8.x-2.5.
